style_hints: light beige interiors with large format tiles
uncertainties: No address; only the settlement name is given.
Unit areas (158/160/165 m²) and room counts are read from the legend icons beside each plan, not a title-block table.
Terrace areas (21 and 40 m²) are printed as approximate ('כ-').
Room dimensions are printed as 'a/b'; which number is width and which is depth is not stated, so the order is kept as printed.
No scale, date, architect or north arrow on any unit plan; the north arrows exist only on the maps.
Shor master bedroom reads 390/345 on the tile but looks like 390/375 in the overview; the tile value is used.
WC rooms in Yarkon and Yarden have dimensions but no label.
The 'כניסה' labels are arrows on the outside, not rooms, so they are not listed as rooms.
Shor has no printed terrace; it has a private yard and a ground-floor patio without dimensions.
Plot numbers on the plot map are not tied to a specific unit.
Window and door positions are read from drawing symbols and may be approximate.
